event.title: Meeting of the Berlin group in Berlin in Berlin, Germany

body.p: The Berlin group of the FSFE meets every 2nd Thursday of the month at Kieztreff Undine. You can find the Undine at Hagenstraße 57, a 5-minute walk from the Lichtenberg underground station, the meeting will be from 6 to 8 pm.
All those interested in Free Software are welcome to come to the meeting. Accessible access to the Kieztreff is possible via the courtyard.
